composition.density: Dense and transactional throughout (the inverse of R02): list rows, stat trios, chip grids; whitespace is functional, not atmospheric.
composition.detail: Doctor header card (avatar, name, specialty, stats trio), About, day strip, slot grid, patient form, fee pinned in the booking CTA.
composition.home: Quiet white header (brand + greeting), search field, specialty chip row, optional upcoming-visit card in the brand tint, then the doctor list.

grammar.avatars: Circular initial avatars on the brand tint; identity comes from typography and layout, not imagery.
grammar.cta: One pill shape, brand fill; the fee is disclosed inside the booking CTA at the decision point.
grammar.errors: Inline, under the field, in the error colour with the field ringed; no modal interruptions.
grammar.numbers: Fee identical on card, detail and confirmation; stats trio = experience / rating / reviews everywhere.
grammar.selection: Filled brand pill for the chosen day and slot; taken slots struck through and disabled; specialty chip selected = brand tint with brand text.
grammar.tabs: Appointments segmented by status in the reference; here a simple list with per-item cancel (brief scope).

imagery.role: None. R15's doctor photos are replaced by initial avatars; the design must work without photography (declared substitution).

provenance.interpreted: Composition, grammar and roles are visual interpretation from the full-resolution board, recorded in mission018/REPORT.md. Font identity is NOT inferred (sans role only).
provenance.measured: engine/analyze_image.py on the original file: sat>=0.25 = 3.88% (vs R02 30.35%), sat>=0.03 = 14.27%, modal hue bin 200deg (blue), brand cluster centre #3070D0, ~82% of pixels are near-white/grey.
uncertainty: Exact brand hex is a cluster centre over a board including photos and grey presentation background; flat CTA fields in the image sit in the #2B6BDE-#3B7BED band.
The reference ships zero error states; the error grammar is extrapolated from its form grammar and is labelled as engine-side invention, not reference fidelity.

typography.displayRole: none — the reference is sans-led at every level; hierarchy comes from weight and size, not a display face
typography.uiRole: clean grotesque sans for everything; semibold for names, prices and CTAs
